Rickshaw puller
Rickshaw puller plays a Important roll in our community. Sector carrying people from one place to another. An unskilled and uncomployed pea man takes rickshaw pulling as his profesion. Sometimes he has to carry goods in his rickshaw. A rickshaw puller is a familer person in a city or town. Rickshaw pulling is a very risky. Because in busy area he can fall a victim in accident. He has to pull ricks for his livelihood. At first he doesn't have any rickshaw, so he hires from its owner on day busis. He has to pull rickshaw on good and bad both weather. Sometimes he wants more fund of foul weather. He doesn't work so hand but earn a little little. He can't save money. He can't provide education, see docter, house etc common human needs. Sometimes they has to starve. His demands are very few. If he get two square meal for himself and his family he will be happy. But sometimes sometimes he earn that few he cant get his demands. So he has to faces difficulties. If he got sick whole family got throble. They can't buy medicines or see doctor. He has been buy food from cheap food stalls. And they live in a remote area in a rented room. We got him in our needs very easily. So we has to due respect to him. If we can help him to give some something.

Our government has to give them a small loan loan. And give them free education, traffic rules. Give them a small shelter for free to lead a better/basic life.
